_comment: Project evaluation suite config (P0.4). Drives the north-star integration test: run_end_to_end.sh with this CONFIG_JSON produces the comparison_summary.csv files, then evaluation_suite.py reads them and emits a PASS/FAIL verdict against the five gates in agents/project_evaluation_northstar.md (Q1-Q3 SP-quality, E1 overhead, E3 INCR_Reopt_X period-monotonicity). Scoped to the user's sizing: N=4/6/8 for SP-quality gates + N=10 as the overhead-only probe for E1; Standard sizing (5 tasksets/N x dur=600s x interval=10s, ~30-40 min with the period arms). All ten schedulers the gates reference are scheduled (union of main+ablation = {BF, INCR_Reopt_1, INCR_Reopt_5, INCR_Reopt_10, INCR_Reopt_30, INCR_Reopt_60, RM, CFS, INCR_NO_TL, INCR_WCET}); the five INCR_Reopt_X arms are plain INCR with ReoptimizationPeriod overridden to X via the mode-string suffix (parsed in tests/RunOrchestrator.cpp). X is the reopt period: X=1 reopts every interval (max reopt), larger X = more incremental. The bare 'INCR' arm was a redundant duplicate of INCR_Reopt_10 (same dispatch path via IsINCRPeriodVariant, same ReoptimizationPeriod=10 -- the YAML default in sources/parameters.yaml) and was dropped from every scheduler list; the Q1/Q2/Q3/E1 gate subject (evaluation_suite.py INCR constant) now reads INCR_Reopt_10, the one arm that is actually run. P2.4 renamed the family from the retired INCR_P<n> form (the P<n> knob ran the wrong way for a reader -- P1 read as incremental but was the max-reopt arm); a stale INCR_P<n> config now fails loudly. INCR_Reopt_5 is a NEW arm (the existing family was {1,10,30,60}). P2.5 removed the INCR_SCRATCH ablation arm and the E2 gate (its only subject pair was INCR-vs-SCRATCH); a stale INCR_SCRATCH config now fails loudly (dispatch falls through to the RM baseline). run_name_prefix='evalsuite' namespaces the run root away from prod/paper runs so the suite never clobbers or is clobbered by them. Use: CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/evaluation_suite_config.json ./scripts/run_evaluation_suite.sh  (or MODE=prod for the full gate run).
_comment_on_naming: All keys use full descriptive names, mirroring experiment_config.json. Times are in seconds unless noted. The eval_* keys are read only by evaluation_suite.py (the gate->N mapping); the pipeline ignores them.

test_mode._comment: Fast smoke: 1 taskset, 70s (>= 2x max hyper-period 66s), N={4,8,10} so every gate has data, all ten schedulers (incl. the five INCR_Reopt_X period arms E3 checks at every N). Validates that the suite runs end-to-end and produces a verdict before launching the ~30-40-min prod run.

prod_mode._comment: Full gate run: 5 tasksets per task count, N={4,6,8,10}, 600s @ interval 10s (~60 scheduling triggers per run). base_random_seed=1000 so tasksets are deterministic and comparable across schedulers. N=4/6/8 are the SP-quality gate points (Q1 small-N=4, Q2/Q3 large-N=8); N=10 is the E1 overhead probe; the five INCR_Reopt_X arms run at every N for the E3 period-monotonicity gate (currently FAILs -- the open P1.1 residual; suite exits red by design until P1.1 resolves). parallel_worker_processes=12 (one scheduler per worker within a taskset; schedulers are independent).

plotting._comment: Publication-quality figure styling (same defaults as experiment_config.json). run_name_prefix='evalsuite' namespaces the run root so the suite's figures/data do not collide with prod or paper runs.

analysis._comment: normalize_sp=true with method 'upper_bound' is REQUIRED by the evaluator: it computes normalized SP = raw_SP / ideal_SP in [0,1] (1.0 = all deadlines met perfectly), independent of any scheduler's realized value. enable_resume_from_existing_results=true so a partial gate run can be resumed by re-invoking the same command. on_taskset_config_change='prompt' (the e2e orchestrator runs non-interactively, so a stale taskset triggers regeneration, not a hang).
